passages.text: Our class sends a thank-you letter to a visitor who showed us how to care for books. Each pupil writes one sentence, and two helpers arrange the sentences on a clean page. We put the finished letter into an envelope and check the address before posting it. A week later, a reply says that our visitor is absolutely delighted to hear what we learned. The class reads the reply together and notices that specific examples made our thanks clear. We keep a copy of both letters in our class record, with the real dates they were sent.

parallelText.en: Our class sends a thank-you letter to a visitor who showed us how to care for books.
parallelText.zh: 我们班给一位曾教我们爱护书本的来访者寄感谢信。

parallelText.en: Each pupil writes one sentence, and two helpers arrange the sentences on a clean page.
parallelText.zh: 每个学生写一句话，两位帮忙者把句子排在一张干净的纸上。

parallelText.en: We put the finished letter into an envelope and check the address before posting it.
parallelText.zh: 我们把写好的信放进信封，寄出前核对地址。

parallelText.en: A week later, a reply says that our visitor is absolutely delighted to hear what we learned.
parallelText.zh: 一周后，回信说来访者极其高兴听到我们学到的东西。

parallelText.en: The class reads the reply together and notices that specific examples made our thanks clear.
parallelText.zh: 全班一起读回信，发现具体例子使我们的感谢表达得很清楚。

parallelText.en: We keep a copy of both letters in our class record, with the real dates they were sent.
parallelText.zh: 我们把两封信的复印件都存入班级记录，标上实际寄出的日期。

passages.text: The school craft group is making a large picture with pieces of coloured paper. Before the work begins, a helper gives each pupil a glove with separate parts for the fingers. The teacher explains that this activity uses a messy paste and shows how to keep the table covered. The group decides to add a paper tree near the edge so that the picture looks more complete. They check the space before putting on the paste, rather than moving sticky pieces many times. When they finish, they remove the covers and leave the work area as tidy as they found it.

parallelText.en: The school craft group is making a large picture with pieces of coloured paper.
parallelText.zh: 学校手工小组正在用彩色纸片制作一幅大画。

parallelText.en: Before the work begins, a helper gives each pupil a glove with separate parts for the fingers.
parallelText.zh: 开始前，一位帮忙者给每个学生发了一只分手指的手套。

parallelText.en: The teacher explains that this activity uses a messy paste and shows how to keep the table covered.
parallelText.zh: 老师解释，这次活动使用容易弄脏桌面的糨糊，并示范如何覆盖桌面。

parallelText.en: The group decides to add a paper tree near the edge so that the picture looks more complete.
parallelText.zh: 小组决定在边缘附近增加一棵纸树，让画面更完整。

parallelText.en: They check the space before putting on the paste, rather than moving sticky pieces many times.
parallelText.zh: 他们先检查空间再涂糨糊，不反复挪动黏着的纸片。

parallelText.en: When they finish, they remove the covers and leave the work area as tidy as they found it.
parallelText.zh: 完成后，他们移去桌面的覆盖物，把工作区域恢复整洁。
